"""Retire closed duplicate logs after exact committed-evidence verification."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import traceback

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/diag-cpu-job-and-raw-bench-20261012')
F = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-12-avx2-expert-roofline-and-paired-gu'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('cpu_retention_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
X = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011')
L = X / '.lint'
ENV = dict(PATH=str(L / 'venv/bin') + ':' + str(L / 'bin') + ':/usr/bin:/bin',
           HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8')


def ident(p):
    return dict(path=str(p), sha256=m.sha(p), bytes=p.stat().st_size)


def absent(owned):
    p = Path('/proc') / str(owned['pid']) / 'stat'
    try:
        value = p.read_text().rsplit(')', 1)[1].split()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return True
    return int(value[19]) != owned['start_ticks']


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-cpu-optimization-retention-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, commands=[],
             source=ident(Path(__file__)), gpu_executed=False)

    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands

    def run(label, argv, wall=180):
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, W, wall=wall, cpu=180,
                             rss_cap=2 << 30, text_cap=4 << 20,
                             total_cap=24 << 20, file_cap=8 << 20)
        r.setdefault('evidence', {})[label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0
        return so.read_text().strip()

    try:
        assert run('head-before', ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == 'f2be61c04fdbcf8956fe88782e4a46d9a5072f37'
        assert not run('status-before', ['/usr/bin/git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        publication_p = B / 'main-cpu-optimization-publish-root-v3/record.json'
        publication = json.loads(publication_p.read_text())
        assert publication['passed'] and publication['complete'] and not publication['active']
        assert publication['revision'] == 'f2be61c04fdbcf8956fe88782e4a46d9a5072f37'
        publication_archive = F / 'receipts/main-cpu-optimization-publish-root-v3.json'
        assert not publication_archive.exists()
        publication_archive.write_text(json.dumps(dict(original=ident(publication_p),
                                                       original_status_preserved=True,
                                                       receipt=publication), indent=2) + '\n')
        plan = []
        keep = []
        for archive in sorted((F / 'receipts').glob('main-cpu-*.json')):
            envelope = json.loads(archive.read_text())
            p = Path(envelope['original']['path'])
            assert ident(p) == envelope['original']
            receipt = json.loads(p.read_text())
            assert receipt == envelope['receipt'] and not receipt['active']
            for command in receipt['commands']:
                assert m.closed(command) and all(absent(v) for v in command['owners'])
                for name, original in command['logs'].items():
                    raw = p.parent / 'commands' / name
                    assert raw.is_file() and not raw.is_symlink()
                    assert raw.stat().st_size == original['bytes'] and m.sha(raw) == original['sha256']
                    suffix = raw.suffix.removeprefix('.')
                    text = receipt['evidence'][command['label']][suffix]
                    assert raw.read_bytes() == text.encode('utf-8')
                    item = dict(original=ident(raw), replacement=str(archive.relative_to(W)),
                                original_status=receipt['passed'], allocated_bytes=raw.stat().st_blocks * 512,
                                reason='Exact text, command, ownership, outcome and individual samples preserved in committed receipt; resolved build/lint failures retain original failed status.')
                    if command['label'] in ('paired-assembly-0', 'paired-assembly-1') and suffix == 'stdout':
                        item.update(owner='Main', consumer='Paired IQ3_S activation-load and stack-access disassembly review',
                                    byte_budget=65536, next_review='After paired model qualification or replacement compiler/disassembly',
                                    reason='Current exact assembly consumer; no spill-free claim made.')
                        keep.append(item)
                    else:
                        plan.append(item)
        assert len(keep) == 2 and sum(v['original']['bytes'] for v in keep) <= 65536
        assert plan and len({v['original']['path'] for v in plan}) == len(plan)
        manifest = dict(phase='planned', deleted=[], kept=keep, source_revision='f2be61c04fdbcf8956fe88782e4a46d9a5072f37',
                        original_statuses_preserved=True, exclusive_measurement_lock=True,
                        retained_receipts_verified=True, fixture_model_and_source_untouched=True)
        manifest_p = F / 'retention-manifest.json'
        assert not manifest_p.exists()
        available_before = os.statvfs(B).f_bavail * os.statvfs(B).f_frsize
        manifest['planned'] = plan
        manifest_p.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
        for item in plan:
            raw = Path(item['original']['path'])
            assert ident(raw) == item['original']
            raw.unlink()
            manifest['deleted'].append(item)
        manifest.update(phase='completed', logical_bytes_deleted=sum(v['original']['bytes'] for v in plan),
                        allocated_bytes_deleted=sum(v['allocated_bytes'] for v in plan),
                        files_deleted=len(plan), available_bytes_before=available_before,
                        available_bytes_after=os.statvfs(B).f_bavail * os.statvfs(B).f_frsize)
        del manifest['planned']
        manifest_p.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
        source_archive = F / 'controllers/main-cpu-optimization-retention-v1.py.json'
        assert not source_archive.exists()
        source_archive.write_text(json.dumps(dict(original=ident(Path(__file__)), content=Path(__file__).read_text()), indent=2) + '\n')
        r['retention'] = manifest
        setup = json.loads((B / 'latest-update-main-finalization-host-root-v8/record.json').read_text())
        assert setup['passed'] and not setup['active']
        ENV.update(GEM_PATH=setup['environment']['GEM_PATH'], RUBYLIB=setup['environment']['RUBYLIB'])
        files = [publication_archive, manifest_p, source_archive]
        run('report-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *map(str, files)], wall=240)
        run('stage', ['/usr/bin/git', 'add', '--', *map(str, files)])
        run('diff-check', ['/usr/bin/git', 'diff', '--cached', '--check'])
        run('commit', ['/usr/bin/git', 'commit', '-m', 'chore(bench): retire duplicate CPU diagnostic logs'])
        r['revision'] = run('head-after', ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push', ['/usr/bin/git', 'push', 'origin', 'HEAD'])
        assert not run('status-after', ['/usr/bin/git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        r['complete'] = True
    except BaseException as e:
        r.update(error=repr(e), traceback=traceback.format_exc())
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        r['passed'] = bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'))
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'error', 'revision')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
